descriptionSections.title: Amenities
descriptionSections.content: Take time to pamper yourself with a visit to the full-service spa. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a health club and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge).

descriptionSections.title: Rooms
descriptionSections.content: Make yourself at home in one of the 153 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Your memory foam bed comes with down comforters. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries.

descriptionSections.title: Renovations
descriptionSections.content: The following facilities or services will be unavailable from December 3 2025 to March 10 2026 (dates subject to change): Swimming pool

descriptionSections.title: Onsite Payments
descriptionSections.content: Visa, Debit cards not accepted, Cash not accepted, American Express, Mastercard

descriptionSections.title: Dining
descriptionSections.content: Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee.

descriptionSections.title: Business Amenities
descriptionSections.content: Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Barasat? This hotel has 10764 square feet (1000 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite.

descriptionSections.title: Location
descriptionSections.content: With a stay at Pride Plaza Hotel, Kolkata, you'll be centrally located in Barasat, within a 5-minute drive of New Town Eco Park and Axis Mall.  This luxury hotel is 8.8 mi (14.2 km) from New Market and 1 mi (1.6 km) from Nazrul Tirtha.
